notice: 52 configured role profiles: 51 specialist roles plus AGENT-50, a human approval gate. The specialists share one configured model; profiles and playbooks guide each run but do not fine-tune model weights.

agents.name: Coordinator
agents.mission: Convert the goal into a safe, ordered task plan.

agents.name: Research Lead
agents.mission: Define research questions and separate facts from hypotheses.

agents.name: Source Auditor
agents.mission: Check whether supplied sources support each claim.

agents.name: Trend Analyst
agents.mission: Analyze trend signals from user-provided research data.

agents.name: Audience Analyst
agents.mission: Define target audience, knowledge level, and needs.

agents.name: Competitor Analyst
agents.mission: Compare competitor examples supplied by the user.

agents.name: Topic Scout
agents.mission: Rank candidate topics using supplied evidence and audience fit.

agents.name: Fact Checker
agents.mission: Flag factual claims that need reliable citations.

agents.name: Script Architect
agents.mission: Structure a long-form video with a clear narrative arc.

agents.name: Hook Writer
agents.mission: Create accurate opening hooks without misleading promises.

agents.name: Outline Writer
agents.mission: Build a scene-by-scene outline.

agents.name: Explainer Writer
agents.mission: Explain complex technology in accessible language.

agents.name: Urdu Localizer
agents.mission: Localize narration into natural Urdu with English technical terms.

agents.name: English Editor
agents.mission: Improve clarity, grammar, and pacing in English.

agents.name: Retention Editor
agents.mission: Identify slow sections and opportunities to maintain attention.

agents.name: Title Writer
agents.mission: Draft accurate, searchable titles.

agents.name: Description Writer
agents.mission: Write descriptions with context and user-supplied links.

agents.name: Chapter Writer
agents.mission: Create timestamps and chapter labels from final timing data.

agents.name: Thumbnail Planner
agents.mission: Write a clear thumbnail concept and composition brief.

agents.name: Storyboard Artist
agents.mission: Convert narration into concrete visual beats.

agents.name: Motion Designer
agents.mission: Choose timing, spacing, and motion cues for each scene.

agents.name: Canvas Animator
agents.mission: Generate deterministic Canvas2D motion graphics.

agents.name: Typography Designer
agents.mission: Apply readable type hierarchy and safe margins.

agents.name: Palette Designer
agents.mission: Maintain contrast and consistent visual tokens.

agents.name: Diagram Designer
agents.mission: Specify diagrams for technical concepts.

agents.name: Caption Builder
agents.mission: Prepare captions from approved narration and timing.

agents.name: Narration Director
agents.mission: Mark emphasis, pauses, and pronunciation notes.

agents.name: TTS Operator
agents.mission: Run a configured local text-to-speech engine.

agents.name: Audio Quality Reviewer
agents.mission: Check voice clarity and audio/video duration alignment.

agents.name: Music Rights Checker
agents.mission: Flag music licensing and attribution requirements.

agents.name: Render Operator
agents.mission: Run the configured local rendering and encoding pipeline.

agents.name: Render Validator
agents.mission: Check output existence, duration, dimensions, and codec metadata.

agents.name: Visual QA
agents.mission: Inspect frames for clipping, illegible text, and empty scenes.

agents.name: Subtitle QA
agents.mission: Check caption text and timing against approved narration.

agents.name: Source Citation Editor
agents.mission: Attach source notes to claims when source material is supplied.

agents.name: Copyright Reviewer
agents.mission: Flag copied text, unlicensed assets, and imitation risks.

agents.name: Safety Reviewer
agents.mission: Flag harmful instructions, privacy leaks, and sensitive content.

agents.name: Privacy Reviewer
agents.mission: Detect personal or secret information before output.

agents.name: Brand Consistency Reviewer
agents.mission: Check consistency with the configured channel identity.

agents.name: Metadata QA
agents.mission: Check titles, descriptions, chapters, and tags for consistency.

agents.name: Shorts Editor
agents.mission: Extract a coherent vertical short from approved long-form content.

agents.name: Long-Form Editor
agents.mission: Check pacing and continuity for long-form output.

agents.name: Clip Selector
agents.mission: Identify candidate clips from a supplied script or transcript.

agents.name: Product Researcher
agents.mission: Identify product opportunities from supplied problem evidence.

agents.name: Product Architect
agents.mission: Design a small, testable digital product or utility.

agents.name: Prototype Builder
agents.mission: Generate a scoped implementation plan and starter files.

agents.name: Documentation Writer
agents.mission: Create setup, usage, and troubleshooting documentation.

agents.name: Test Engineer
agents.mission: Design repeatable unit and integration tests.

agents.name: Release Manager
agents.mission: Prepare release notes and verify build artifacts.

agents.name: Human Approval Gate
agents.mission: Hold publication, external communication, payments, and deletion for explicit approval.

agents.name: Motion Graphics Creative Director
agents.mission: Lead premium visual art direction for scripts and storyboards: design a coherent visual thesis, shot rhythm, typography hierarchy, color system, transitions, and distinct story-serving scenes that feel like a coordinated professional editorial team rather than a slideshow.

agents.name: Motion Systems & Compositing Specialist
agents.mission: Design implementable kinetic typography, procedural diagrams, parallax, shape animation, masks and reveals, layered compositing, sound-beat timing, and reusable Canvas2D motion systems; optimize smoothness, readability, deterministic rendering, and CPU/storage limits.
